static_traits.name: Lin Shaman
static_traits.social_status: Having friends and family to talk to, but not yet discussing these feelings with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history; no similar problem history
static_traits.language_features: Speaks clearly, can describe emotions and experiences concretely; dejected tone; cooperation acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt I will never be able to visit all the places I want to go, which disappoints me and gives me a feeling of missing out on life experiences.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this sense of loss about travel experiences has begun to affect my overall well-being and daily motivation.
growth_experiences: After turning 30, realizing there are still many places never visited, producing Fear and loss about missing life experiences and being unable to realize dreams; whenever Seeing others share travel experiences on social media, these feelings are repeatedly triggered, gradually affecting daily mood and motivation.

core_beliefs: I will miss important life experiences
I am unable to realize my dreams

special_situations.event: Seeing others share travel experiences on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others travel more and have richer experiences, I am being left behind, meaning my life is incomplete
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Making a travel wish list, planning future trips to 'catch up with others'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never catch up with them, my life is slipping away from me.

special_situations.event: Realizing after the 30th birthday that one has not yet visited many places
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the set travel goals are not completed before a certain age milestone, it means they will never be completed later either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Measures progress by black-and-white standards, sets a rigid timetable for oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is already too late; either achieve it all, otherwise it is failure.

special_situations.event: At a gathering with friends, everyone talks about careers and promotions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as them, it means I am not good enough and am being left behind
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Leaves early, avoids such occasions, and tells friends 'everything is fine' to avoid being pitied
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, I will never escape this predicament.

special_situations.event: Received a job application rejection letter
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If unable to find stable Work, there will be no way to fund travel, all wishes will be permanently dashed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing communication with others, intensifying self-criticism to temporarily ease Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never find Work, and never get to the places I want to go.

core_conflict.wish: Longing for Freedom to explore the world, fully enjoy life, and be understood and accepted by others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being left behind, being judged as not good enough, thus losing value and connection
defense_goal: Reducing shame and Anxiety by avoiding comparison situations and masking true feelings
Maintains a sense of control with strict self-rules (must complete all wishes)

object_relations.object_representation: Successful others/groups who do not understand oneself

object_relations.self_representation: Insufficient, someone who needs to catch up
object_relations.object_representation: Judgmental, comparison-inducing onlookers (others on social media)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests setting structured rest and schedules (such as separating job hunting from relaxation)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Rest equals procrastination and will eventually make oneself more disappointed (tendency to interpret suggestions as possibly leading to failure)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a worried tone, emphasize 'resting will cause delays and worse outcomes', use 'if... then...' reasoning, stay reserved about suggestions and raise multiple concerns.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor inquires whether he discussed real feelings with friends and sought support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Friends will not understand oneself, will only cast pitying looks (transference: Projecting one's own shame as others' judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoid going into details, use generalized wording like 'they do not understand', reduce self-disclosure, maintain psychological distance from others.

manifestations: After 30, realizing there are still many unfulfilled travel wishes, feeling life is incomplete
Seeing others travel on social media triggers strong feelings of missing out and falling behind
outcomes: Difficulty engaging in other interests and activities

manifestations: Unwilling to discuss true feelings with friends, thinking they are 'on a different planet'
Leaves gatherings early and makes excuses to avoid comparison and being pitied
outcomes: Social withdrawal and worsening sense of Loneliness
More prone to rumination under job-search pressure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly blaming oneself 'I am not good enough' 'I will never find Work'
Worrying that rest equals procrastination, finding it hard to allow oneself relaxation without guilt

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Leaving gatherings early using 'the dog needs me' as an excuse
Says 'everything is fine' to friends to avoid talking directly about real feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not asking friends for help or expressing stress, bottling up emotions
Staying in bed during Low mood, reducing activities instead of seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of job-hunting setbacks and social comparison, the client usually falls into Self-denial and Low mood, finding it hard to carry out daily activities.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When playing with pet dog Bella, able to briefly detach from stress and negative thoughts, soothed by 'non-judgmental companionship', mood noticeably lightened.
exception_events.reason: Different support and situation: non-judgmental interaction with the pet, focusing on the present and physical activity bringing attention Displacement and soothing experience.

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing others share travel or Receiving a job application rejection letter, the client usually ruminates and feels left behind, leading to Decreased drive.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When walking outside, can briefly gain focus and ease amid walking and environmental changes, and the intensity of negative thoughts slightly decreases.
exception_events.reason: Different situation and approach: outdoor environment and light exercise promoting mind-body regulation, attention Displaced from comparison and failure themes to present-moment experience.

positive_force: Has the pet's emotional support and present-experience ability (interacting with Bella can reduce negative thoughts)
Willing to try small-step actions and build structure (such as proposing the idea of walking the dog at a fixed 2 p.m.)
Has a fair-sized support network of friends and family
Awareness of actively seeking help: recognizes the problem affects life and seeks counseling
negative_force: Catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, mental filtering and negating-the-positive cognitive patterns
Social comparison causing inferiority and shame
Job-hunting setbacks triggering rumination and Disrupted sleep rhythm
Avoiding communication and leaving-early behavior patterns worsening Loneliness and low motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and masking (telling friends 'all is well', leaving early)
antecedent: Hearing others talk about careers and promotions at gatherings
target_behavior.core_reason: Triggering low self-esteem and shame in social comparison, trying to reduce feelings of being judged and pitied through avoidance and masking
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome stimuli (comparison and being judged), short-term relief of Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Isolation worsens, missing support and genuine connection, negative emotions persist

antecedent: Ruminating after Receiving a job application rejection letter
Low mood after comparing with others
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent worry and rumination triggered by job-seeking setbacks and a sense of missing out, affecting physiological rhythms
target_behavior.function: In the short term, tries to escape stress through sleep changes or cope with exhaustion through rest
target_behavior.consequence: Daytime Decreased drive and reduced activities, further weakening job-hunting and life structure

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial and catastrophic automatic thoughts ('I will never find Work' 'I will never get to those places')
antecedent: Received a job application rejection letter
target_behavior.core_reason: The inner rigid rule of 'must achieve everything to count as success' and Fear of missing out, triggering black-and-white and future-predicting cognitive biases
target_behavior.function: Trying to avoid dashed hopes and uncertainty-induced Anxiety through preemptive negation
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and helplessness intensifying, behavioral motivation declining further

target_behavior.behavior: Reduced activity and low motivation (difficulty doing basic things such as cooking and cleaning)
antecedent: Consecutive job-search setbacks and accumulated rejection letters
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative rumination and Self-denial consuming psychological resources, leading to task avoidance and insufficient behavioral activation
target_behavior.function: In the short term avoids demands or failure experiences, reducing the immediate pressure of facing setbacks
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life, loss of structure, feelings of failure and missing out further Reinforced
